draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.29, the 52nd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 3rd of 19 at LB. He lasted until pick 155, well after his grade rank (52nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Nick Bolton. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (3rd percentile), 20-yard shuttle (14th percentile). College production: 87 tackles in 2023, 8th of 19 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Philadelphia Eagles. 34 career games and 2 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (19th percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 off-ball linebacker who played: 32 combined tackles against a median of 35, below the norm.
